tolerances.identity_flag: residual <= 1e-10 * max(1, largest term), terms relative to ||A||_F^2

definitions.cross: -2 Re <D, B - B_r>, <X,Y> = tr(X^H Y); ||Bstar-B_r||^2 = ||D||^2 + ||B-B_r||^2 + cross
definitions.cond_c: sigma_max(C)/sigma_min(C), C = Psi Q, via torch.linalg.svdvals
definitions.stationarity_rel: ||C^H (C B - W)||_F / (||C||_2 ||C B - W||_F), null when the residual is at the noise floor
definitions.ideal_r: Q (Q^H A)_r, rank-r truncation inside the sketched range
definitions.psi_prefix48: first d rows of one 48-row Gaussian Psi (seed 900000): nested draws
definitions.psi_seeded: independent 24-row Gaussian Psi (seed 900000+k), A and Q fixed
definitions.sequential: Psi drawn from the sketch generator after Omega, Phi, as in sketch_power_low_rank (M4 convention)
